snippet.title: Relic Guardian Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Relic Guardian - Tower Defense is OUT NOW on Steam!

Relic Guardian is a visually striking pixel-art tower defense game with an action-packed twist. Developed by the indie team Mystrigger, Relic Guardian transforms traditional tower defense gameplay into a dynamic battlefield where strategy and adaptability are key.

Download the Demo NOW on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2064610/Relic_Guardian__Tower_Defense/
